mapper.select: SELECT wc.id FROM work_cases wc WHERE wc.status = 'READY' AND wc.starts_at <= #{noShowAt} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_records ar WHERE ar.work_case_id = wc.id AND ar.attendance_type = 'CHECK_IN' AND ar.result = 'SUCCESS' ) ORDER BY wc.starts_at, wc.id

SELECT wc.id FROM work_cases wc WHERE wc.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND wc.ends_at <= #{checkoutMissingAt} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_records check_in WHERE check_in.work_case_id = wc.id AND check_in.attendance_type = 'CHECK_IN' AND check_in.result = 'SUCCESS' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_records check_out WHERE check_out.work_case_id = wc.id AND check_out.attendance_type = 'CHECK_OUT' AND check_out.result = 'SUCCESS' ) ORDER BY wc.ends_at, wc.id
SELECT id AS workCaseId, status AS status, starts_at AS startsAt, ends_at AS endsAt FROM work_cases WHERE id = #{workCaseId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM work_cases wc JOIN workplaces w ON w.id = wc.workplace_id AND w.owner_user_id = wc.employer_id JOIN work_invitations wi ON wi.work_case_id = wc.id AND wi.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND wi.accepted_by_user_id = wc.worker_id AND wi.expected_terms_version = wc.terms_version AND wi.accepted_terms_version = wc.terms_version AND wi.accepted_at IS NOT NULL JOIN work_contracts contract ON contract.work_case_id = wc.id AND contract.employer_id = wc.employer_id AND contract.worker_id = wc.worker_id AND contract.agreed_wage = wc.agreed_wage AND contract.source_terms_version = wc.terms_version JOIN escrows escrow ON escrow.work_case_id = wc.id AND escrow.amount = wc.agreed_wage AND escrow.status = 'HELD' JOIN settlements settlement ON settlement.work_case_id = wc.id AND settlement.amount = wc.agreed_wage AND settlement.status = 'WAITING' AND settlement.due_at IS NULL JOIN documents document ON document.work_case_id = wc.id AND document.document_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT' AND document.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN document_versions original_version ON original_version.document_id = document.id AND original_version.version_type = 'ORIGINAL' JOIN document_versions signed_version ON signed_version.document_id = document.id AND signed_version.version_type = 'SIGNED' JOIN document_signatures signature ON signature.document_id = document.id AND signature.source_version_id = original_version.id AND signature.signed_version_id = signed_version.id AND signature.signer_user_id = wc.worker_id AND signature.source_checksum = original_version.checksum AND signature.signed_checksum = signed_version.checksum JOIN document_shares share ON share.document_id = document.id AND share.work_case_id = wc.id AND share.shared_with_user_id = wc.worker_id AND share.purpose = 'CONTRACT_PARTY' AND share.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE wc.id = #{workCaseId} AND wc.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND wc.worker_id IS NOT NULL AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' AND w.latitude IS NOT NULL AND w.longitude IS NOT NULL )
